bio.title: Bio
items: As an expert in software engineering and information technology, I am passionate about designing innovative solutions. I have developed a hybrid profile, combining technical rigor with strong visual and auditory creativity, which I cultivate through personal projects.

With a strong ability to learn independently and proven experience in managing complex projects, I am eager to apply my skills to real-world challenges. I am currently open to permanent or fixed-term positions, as well as CIFRE industrial PhD proposals.
